meta.title: Shanghai Couple Culinary & Cultural Trip — 2027 Planning Edition
meta.subtitle: Source-linked planning dashboard for 2 adults, Feb 15–Mar 23, 2027; exact availability and passport nationality were not supplied.
meta.fx_reference_note: Hotel checkout quotes on guide.michelin.com are dated USD snapshots checked 2026-11-26, not current availability. Direct hotel, restaurant PDF menu, metro, and municipal attraction prices remain in their published currency. Any USD examples for US visa fees are conditional on the relevant traveler holding a US passport and must be rechecked with the competent consular authority; they are not assumed for this couple.
